Folks — forwarding Helix's replies (see below). High level ask: they want a predictable monthly cap for add-ons and are asking about 24-month commit discounts.

My initial pricing sketch (very rough):
- Audit logs: $0.60 / GB-month for hot ingest/retention; discounted to $0.42 / GB-month with a 24-month volume commit (equivalent to ~30% off). For very large retention (2+ years cold archive) we can offer a flat archival tier at $0.08/GB-month.
- Managed KMS: $2k / month (managed by Redwood) for pilot; HSM seat: $6k / month (per HSM appliance seat) or an alternative throughput-based pass-through at $0.015 / req if they want usage-based instead of seat.
- Residency surcharge: +12% on top of base because of reserved capacity and compliance certifications (EU region planned for P2). We can reduce to +8% with a 24-month restricted-scope commit.

Concessions we can offer: 1) Pilot credit $30k to offset initial HSM setup or KMS managed fees; 2) 15% off list on add-ons for a 24-month commitment; 3) Option to amortize implementation/validation fee over the first 6 invoices.

Questions for legal/pricing: are we comfortable presenting HSM seat pricing as monthly fixed (6k) or do we prefer recommending pass-through for larger customers? Also want to validate the archival tier wording with Marissa — are there any regulatory gotchas for a $0.08 archival tier?

Thanks — Priyom

Emily / Tim — thanks for the clarity. Per internal alignment, here's a concise package you can review:

Option A (Pilot-first, US-only):
- Managed KMS for pilot: $2,000 / month
- Audit logs: $0.60 / GB-month (standard)
- Residency surcharge: none (US-only)
- Pilot credit: $30,000 applied to first 2 invoices
- Implementation/validation fee: $45,000 (option to amortize across first 6 monthly invoices)

Option B (24-month committed bundle — production):
- Audit logs: $0.42 / GB-month (24-month commit, 30% off)
- HSM: $6,000 / seat / month OR throughput pass-through at $0.012 / request (choose one)
- Residency surcharge: +8% (for committed EU rollover)
- Add-ons discount: 15% off list for all compliance add-ons with 24-month commitment
- SLA: 99.9% region-level availability for inference and audit log ingestion

We can also propose a blended monthly cap model if finance needs predictability: estimate monthly usage and cap at that number; any overage would be billed at the committed price with quarterly true-ups. If you'd like, I can populate the attached pricing_workbook.xlsx with Helix's expected volumes so we can propose a concrete monthly cap.
